jobs.title: Mobile Application Developer – React Native
jobs.description: About Us Metayb is a fast-growing digital transformation company empowering organizations to thrive in the digital-first era. In just three years, we've built a team of 450+ experts focused on creating seamless customer experiences, boosting operational efficiency, and delivering actionable insights. Our core strengths include Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Finance, and Supply Chain services, with aspirations to expand into IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality. By leveraging emerging technologies, Metayb aims to be a trusted global partner in delivering impactful, future-ready solutions. Job Description We are seeking an experienced React Native Developer to build and maintain high-quality mobile applications for both iOS and Android platforms. As a key contributor, you will be responsible for translating design mockups into fully functional applications, optimizing performance, and ensuring seamless user experiences. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams throughout the application lifecycle, from conception to deployment. Key Responsibilities Develop, test, and deploy mobile applications using React Native for iOS and Android platforms. Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend developers to define application features and requirements. Ensure application responsiveness, scalability, and optimal performance. Integrate APIs and third-party libraries into mobile applications. Implement security and data protection standards across mobile solutions. Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues in a timely manner. Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, and usability. Maintain clear documentation for code, processes, and system design. Stay updated with emerging mobile development technologies and apply them to ongoing projects. Required Skills And Qualifications 2 to 4 years of proven experience as a Mobile Application Developer, with at least 2+ years in React Native. Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript. Proficiency in mobile UI design principles and building pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces. Experience with mobile frameworks and tools such as Redux, Context API, React Navigation. Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON, and third-party integrations. Familiarity with native build tools (Xcode, Android Studio, Gradle). Experience with mobile app deployment on App Store and Google Play Store. Knowledge of mobile security best practices. Experience with Git and version control systems. Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile applications is an added advantage. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Excellent teamwork and communication abilities. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. Disclaimer The job title mentioned in this description is generic and intended for broad categorization purposes. The final designation will be determined based on the candidate’s performance during the interview process, relevant experience, and alignment with the organizational hierarchy.
